description: This file is a shell script designed to test protocol filtering with Git submodules. It sets up a repository with submodules, tests cloning with submodule recursion, and verifies protocol restrictions via environment variables.

methods.name: setup_ext_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up the external protocol wrapper environment for testing.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up SSH wrapper environment for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit in a repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test expecting success, with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.
